name: filetree-coverage
description: Maps a folder of documents and passively records which files each question's answer listed, searched, opened or named; renders a radial file tree with a per-question and a cumulative view and a list of files nothing ever opened.

plugins.name: filetree-coverage
plugins.description: Data room coverage for AI-assisted diligence, recorded passively from the session's own tool calls (map, work, show), and a chronology of governing documents that separates amendments from restatements and drafts from operative instruments. Audits of what was touched and what governs, not certificates of completeness.
